pages.text: The Storage Monitor is a block that displays the amount of a specific item or fluid in your storage network. It provides a visual indicator of resource levels.
Features:$(li)Display item or fluid quantities$(li)Real-time updates$(li)Configurable display item$(li)Redstone output based on quantity$(li)Can be used with comparators

To use the Storage Monitor:$(li)Place it within range of your Controller$(li)Connect it to your network using cables$(li)Right-click to configure$(li)Set the item or fluid to monitor$(li)Configure redstone output if desired
